nhse01.title: Nine Invites
nhse01.caption: When every weekend in December fills up, it's easy to forget you're allowed to say no. Pick the gatherings you'd truly miss, send a warm note to the rest, and keep one day just for rest.

nhse02.title: Small Budget, Big Heart
nhse02.caption: Worried your gift isn't big enough? The ones people keep are the ones that prove you were listening. Think back to something they loved this year and make it personal.

nhse03.title: Plus-One Short
nhse03.caption: Walking into a party of couples on your own can feel lonely for about five minutes. You're not missing a half. Go say hi to someone new, and maybe the host's dog.

nhse04.title: Social Battery: 2%
nhse04.caption: If the party is loud and you're running on empty, you don't have to hide in the coat pile. Tell someone you're stepping out for ten quiet minutes, then come back when you're ready.

nhse05.title: Out of Office
nhse05.caption: Still answering work messages at the holiday table? Set the auto-reply and trust it. The work will wait for you, and the people beside you are only here for a little while.

nhse06.title: It's a Gift Swap, Not a Final
nhse06.caption: Gift swaps get competitive fast. The best part was never the prize: it's laughing together when the plan falls apart. Play to have fun, and let the candle go.
